warnings: Axes: x = 1-2 (4.00, one bay); y = A-D (4.00 each). Origin A1. Every line is printed on the S sheets — nothing scaled.

Bay C-D holds the stair and its footings: six dummy lines C' .. C'''''' come from two different chains (S-02 footings 1.00/0.50/0.60/1.00/0.90, S-03 floor 1.35-split 0.35/1.65/1.10/0.90); both chains end at 11.10 before D, so that line is shared.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget for this batch) — z_levels holds only the ground datum printed on the S sheets.
